title_block.title: Internal analytical release audit
title_block.subtitle: Compound-card traceability and delivery-lot purity reconciliation
lines: Prepared by Clara Fenwick, Analytical Release Lead

blocks.p: This audit checks the analytical release records for the most recent delivery lots. It covers compound-card traceability, the transcription of purity results onto the compound cards, and the reconciliation of purity between the release records and the delivery paperwork.
The audit was run as an internal check. It does not replace the client's own acceptance testing.

list: Every compound card in the release set was traced back to its delivery lot and isolated-material record
Purity values on each card were compared with the release HPLC report by area percent at the stated wavelength
The delivery paperwork was compared with the lot list held by the sample desk

list.text: Cards with no release report on file were held back and not counted as passed

blocks.p: The analytical source records were retained. The two corrected transcription findings and their closure evidence are summarised below; the detailed correction history remains with the audit records.

rows: Transcription finding recorded in the audit records.
Correction retained with the compound card; source analytical record retained.
Second transcription finding recorded in the audit records.
Correction retained with the compound card; reconciliation documented in the release records.
table.caption: Table 1 Audit findings and corrections

blocks.p: Both transcription findings have been corrected. Refer to the audit correction records for the affected entries and checks; no new analytical result is created by this note.

Closure evidence for delivery-lot purity reconciliation is retained with the release records. The corrected compound cards are reconciled to their analytical source records and linked to the delivery-lot documentation.

list: Compound cards re-checked against the release reports after the corrections
Delivery notes re-checked against the lot list
Release reports filed with the delivery lot records

blocks.p: The correction history and reconciliation checks form the closure evidence for this audit.
Compound-card traceability and delivery-lot purity reconciliation are documented in the audit records. The two transcription findings are corrected and closed with the evidence summarised above.
The audit will be repeated at the next quarter's release review. Compound-card transcription is to be checked against the final release report, not the draft.
